character: Road course built inside the Indianapolis Motor Speedway oval, combining a stretch of the famous banking with a tight, technical infield section. Traction out of the infield hairpins and a clean run onto the oval banking define the lap.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.type: tight right-hander off the front straight
corners.technique: Brake hard, late apex, prioritise a clean exit into the infield
corners.trap: Over-braking and losing momentum into the technical infield section

corners.name: Turn 7
corners.type: tight hairpin at the end of Hulman Straight
corners.technique: Hard braking, patient entry, progressive throttle on exit
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed in and missing the apex

corners.name: Turn 12-14
corners.technique: Smooth, rhythmic direction changes through the sequence
corners.trap: Over-driving any single apex disrupts the whole complex

corners.name: Turn 16
corners.type: final corner onto the oval banking
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit is critical — feeds the run down the front straight
corners.trap: Compromised exit costs time down the entire straight
